DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome (manifesting as PDA causing heart failure/apnea and Coombs-negative anemia).

I have noted your baby is one month old, born preterm at 32 weeks due to placental insufficiency, and that maternal rubella immunity was absent. Given the history of non-immune rubella and symptoms of apnea/anemia, I need to confirm the presence of congenital heart defects and anemia type.

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Blood Smear, and Echocardiogram.
